summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 league campaign with an impressive 3-1 victory over Wednesfield CFC, with new signing Bevan scoring twice to lead the Ramblers to three points. The team showed great early cohesion despite fielding five new players in the starting lineup, and showed resilience to come from 1-1 down at halftime. It was a perfect start to the season with a strong performance that will give the squad plenty of confidence going forward.
